topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: I just can't shake the conversation we had about Gram's house. I know we both love it, but it's so much to handle, especially now. I worry about the responsibilities, the memories—it's overwhelming. I hope I didn't come off too strongly when I suggested selling. It's not that I don’t value what it means to us; it's just about what’s best for us moving forward. I really want us to make the right choice, one that honors Gram and takes care of us too. Maybe we should talk to Aunt Sarah, get her thoughts on what Gram might have wanted. What do you think?
